name: ai-code-reviewer
description: AI-powered code review tool that detects bugs, security issues, and suggests improvements using the Claude API. Available as a CLI and a web dashboard.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env || true
